text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — metering: token_count_drift. Probable symptom: consumer lag + duplicate emits causing transient overage flags. Severity: P2. Runbook: metering-emit-pager.

sara-oncall: Taking lead, ack. seeing +11% token delta over expected in last 20m. Kafka consumer lag on topic 'usage-emitter' ~120k messages.

liam-metering: ack, I'm on it. checking emitter logs and consumer offsets. any customer-facing alerts yet?

nina-support: no customer emails so far. monitoring dashboards show spike in overage flags but not charged. will escalate if customers ping.

jay-billing: billing pipelines show late-window jump at ~12:03 UTC; minute-window aggregator has duplicate keys around 00:30-00:50. looks like retry amplification after consumer restarts.

liam-metering: found repeated writes from emitter retry path. stack snippet: `emitter/retry.go:82` shows `if !idempotent { write() }` — idempotency marker not set on replay after ack timeout.

sara-oncall: Can we pause the emitter to prevent more duplicates? What's the risk of pausing producer vs letting it run?

liam-metering: we can pause consumer group to stop processing duplicates while we triage. executing: `kafka-consumer pause --group metering-emitter` now.

incident-bot: Action logged: consumer group metering-emitter paused by liam-metering at 6150009999.

jay-billing: Pausing reduced incoming duplicates. Next steps: freeze shadow counts for affected windows and run dedupe job to reconcile.

sara-oncall: @nina-support please prep a short customer status: "We detected transient overage flags due to delayed/duplicate token emissions; we're preventing further duplicates and reconciling counts. No billing adjustments applied yet; we will follow up." Keep it concise.

nina-support: Drafting now, will post after CS review.

devin-cs: Customer impact: three enterprise tenants saw overage alerts. Reached out proactively; no billing applied yet. forwarding any replies to billing.

liam-metering: launching dedupe dry-run for 00:30-00:50 window. Command: ```bash
./tools/dedupe --topic usage-emitter --start 2025-03-12T00:30Z --end 2025-03-12T00:50Z --out dryrun
```

sara-oncall: Run dryrun first, confirm delta, then apply.

liam-metering: Dryrun results: net duplicate tokens = 42,315 (duplicates). Will schedule apply in 10m after CS ok.

nina-support: CS approved the message. Posting now to status.redwood and attaching this thread.

michael-eng: Quick Q — should billing hold invoices for those tenants until reconciliation confirmed? Jay?

jay-billing: Opening ledger hold LH-615000; will suspend invoice generation for affected account windows and tag for manual review until reconciler reports.

sara-oncall: Good. After dedupe and ledger holds, schedule reconciliation run and confirm with CS+support.

liam-metering: Starting dedupe apply. Monitoring progress: 8% -> 72% -> complete. Dedupe applied, corrected -42,315 tokens for the window; emitting reconciliation events to billing.

incident-bot: Dedupe job completed at 6150010105.

jay-billing: Reconciler consumed events, adjustments staged in shadow ledger; no customer charges have been applied. Running final billing-run simulation and will report delta.

devin-cs: Customers notified; two replied asking for ETA on final confirmation. Forwarded to Jay for confirmation.

sara-oncall: Current status: mitigated — duplicates stopped, dedupe completed, ledger holds in place. Keeping thread open for postmortem notes; will schedule incident writeup. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

michael-eng: +1. Please add regression tests for retry path and link PR to incident report.

liam-metering: Raising PR to add idempotency token to retry path, tests included — PR #4891.

sara-oncall: Closing oncall handoff in 30m. Great work everyone.

nina-support: Closing customer comms; will update status page after billing sim completes.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated and flagged for postmortem at 6150010300.
